title: The Myth of Productivity Hacks
hook: "Are productivity hacks really making you more efficient?"
script:
(A visually-driven script with animations and text overlays)

Narrator: "We've all been there - scrolling through social media, seeing everyone's 'productivity tips' and 'time management tricks'. But have we stopped to think if these hacks are actually working for us?"

(Visuals of people stuck in traffic, staring at their phones, etc.)

Narrator: "Productivity hacks often promise quick fixes, but what about the underlying assumptions? Let's take a step back and question some common beliefs."

(Cut to animations illustrating first-principles thinking)

Narrator: "What if our assumption is that more work = more productivity?"

(Cut to visuals of people working long hours, only to feel burnt out)

Narrator: "But what about the costs? What if all this extra work is actually decreasing our productivity in the long run?"

(Closing shot with a thought-provoking question)
caption: "Challenge your assumptions. Question the status quo. Productivity hacks might not be the answer. #RationalThoughts #FirstPrinciplesThinking"
